title: Add slugify and a CLI for it
body: Add lib/slug.js exporting slugify(s): lowercase, every run of non-alphanumeric characters becomes one '-', no leading or trailing '-' ('Hello, World!' -> 'hello-world'). Export it from index.js as slugify next to the existing exports. Make cli.js print slugify(process.argv[2]). Do not edit test.js. Commit on this card's branch.
